item.title: Ｇ２０外相、集合写真を見送り 欧州やカナダがロシア同席に反発
item.description: [アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - 主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の外相は３０日、米アトランタで開かれた会合を前に、恒例の集合写真の撮影を見送った。欧州の出席者がロシアの同席に反発したことが背景にある。

米当局者によると、国務省は、集合写真が「見せ物」になったり、会合の妨げになったりすることを望まなかったことから、写真撮影を公式日程から外したという。

西側諸国のある外交官によると、オーストラリアやカナダを含む出席者の３分の１が、ロシアのラブロフ外相との撮影に反対する意向を明確にしたという。

ドイツのワデフル外相は３０日、会合に先立ち記者団に対し、「欧州のパートナー諸国とラブロフ氏が一緒に写る集合写真は、いかなる場合もあり得ない。ロシアとの関係に正常な状態などないからだ」と述べた。

欧州の当局者は当初、ラブロフ氏を含む写真と含まない写真の２枚を別々に撮影する案を示していたという。

item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
まちまちで取引を終えた。製薬株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。月間ベースでは１．１７％高と、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（30日） 4:31 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。製薬株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。月間ベースでは１．１７％高と、３カ月ぶりに上昇した。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．８９％安と反落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は５．１０％高。製薬大手アストラゼネカは７．０％上昇。組織再編計画の発表が買い材料視された。

一方、銀行株指数は３．１９％安。銀行大手ナットウエストは８．８％下落。金利収入の見通しが予想を下回ったことを受けて、売りが膨らんだ。

金や銅が値下がりしたことを受けて、貴金属株指数は５．２８％、鉱業株指数は２．８６％それぞれ下落した。

石油大手のＢＰは０．５％高。２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が過去最高となり、買いが優勢だった。ブリティッシュ・アメリカン・タバコは１．７％、日用品のユニリーバは２．１％それぞれ上昇した。

ヒーリー英財務相は今週、初の予算案を発表。課税の引き上げ幅が懸念された程ではなかったとして関連株が上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は月間ベースでは１．８７％高と、上昇率は今年６月以来の大きさとなった。

米アマゾン・ドット・コムや半導体大手インテルの決算発表を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラ投資を巡る懸念が再燃した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．７３％下落。フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは９．６％、イタリアのテクノプローブは９．０％、それぞれ下落した。

一方、メディア株指数は１．６３％高。直近四半期の決算発表を受けて、音楽大手ユニバーサル・ミュージック・グループ（ＵＭＧ）は７．９％値上がりした。

ドイツの製薬・化学大手バイエルは５．５％高。除草剤の発がん性を巡る３人の女性による訴訟で、バイエル側の主張を支持する判断が下されたことが買い材料視された。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス国債利回りが再び急上昇した。この日発表の指標で、同国経済が予想外に縮小した一方、インフレ率の伸びが加速したことが示された。

フランスの第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比０．１％減となり、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想の０．１％増に反して縮小した。一方、消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）は前年比３．８％上昇し、２０２３年終盤以来の水準に加速し、予想の３．６％を上回った。

パンテオン・マクロエコノミクスのユーロ圏担当チーフエコノミスト、クラウス・ビステセン氏は「これらの数字は芳しくなく、公的部門のより迅速かつ広範な財政再建を求める圧力を強めるだろう」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９７％。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇の４．５０％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１６５ｂｐに拡大した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは横ばいで推移した。

短期金融市場が織り込む欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による来月の利上げ確率は約９０％。ＥＣＢは２９日、政策金利を予想通り据え置くと決定した。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

item.title: フーシ派、アデン空港と大統領官邸にミサイル攻撃＝イエメン政府軍
item.description: [３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[３０日 ロイター] - イエメン政府軍の報道官は３０日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が同国南部のアデン空港と大統領宮殿施設を弾道ミサイルで攻撃したと明らかにした。

声明では、死傷者や被害の状況、ミサイルが標的に命中したかどうかの詳細は明らかにされなかった。

item.title: Oil jumps 2%, settles at 6-month highs on fears of escalation in Iran
item.description: HOUSTON, Oct 30 : Oil prices jumped more than 2 per cent on Friday and settled at their highest levels since the end of April, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks.Brent crude

item.content:encoded:

FAST

HOUSTON, Oct 30 : Oil prices jumped more than 2 per cent on Friday and settled at their highest levels since the end of April, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks. Brent crude futures for December, which expired on Friday, settled up $2.76, or 2.4 per cent, at $117.64 a barrel, after touching a high of $118. The more active January contract gained $2.63 to $113.43. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures settled $2.12, or 2.08 per cent, higher at $104.12. For the month, Brent finished 13.6 per cent higher, while WTI rose 15.2 per cent.

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.  On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by explosive devices attached by a small boat, said the UKMTO, the British maritime security service. It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack in the strait, the key sea outlet for Gulf crude and fuel supplies.  It was the first known successful strike in the waterway using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull from a small boat, since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said. 'HIGHER LIKELIHOOD OF AN ESCALATION' The US ordered non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia effective October 23 due to safety risks, the US embassy in Riyadh said on Friday, citing Houthi attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure. Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militants said on Thursday they had attacked several sites in Saudi Arabia, including the large Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Rabigh refinery and a production facility in Abqaiq owned by state oil company Saudi Aramco.  A Saudi-led coalition also said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region. Meanwhile, Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday as part of coordinated efforts to reach a deal between the US and Iran, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters. US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance had reached out to Iran to help the country get medical supplies, after US media reported Vance had written to Tehran's top security official to revive peace talks. Iran has received a letter from Vance, but it has not responded to it yet, Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, adding that Tehran wants the US to meet its conditions and "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable." Oil prices could become even more volatile in the next couple of weeks due to Israel's recent elections and the US midterm elections on November 3, according to a Saxo Bank briefing on Thursday. The Danish bank said crude is expected to trade in a higher range of $70 to $90 a barrel even after the conflict ends, compared with a pre-war range of $60 to $70. SAUDI EXPORTS RISE Saudi Arabia's crude exports rose in October from September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite Iranian attacks on shipping in the Gulf and claims by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis of attacks on Saudi oil facilities. The US oil rig count, an indicator of future output, rose by two. US crude oil output increased in August, while demand for crude oil and petroleum products declined, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its Petroleum Supply Monthly report on Friday. Meanwhile, Libya's National Oil Corporation said an armed group shut a valve on Friday on the main Hamada crude oil pipeline, which links the Hamada field to the Zawiya refinery. It said the closure of the valve had halted the flow of about 15,000 barrels per day.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ロシア独立紙「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」廃刊へ、当局の圧力で
item.description:
Andrew Osborn Nika Khutsieva
[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Osborn　Nika Khutsieva

[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] - ロシアの独立系新聞「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」は３０日、１１月９日に全ての活動を終了すると発表した。当局による一連の圧力により編集幹部が起訴され、資金面の支援や事務所も失ったとしている。

同紙は声明で「われわれは殺された。１１月９日に、３０年間過ごしてきたわが家の明かりを消し、サーバーを停止して立ち去る。新聞はもはや存在しない。ロシア当局と治安機関が、われわれ編集部を活動終了に追い込んだ」と発表した。

同紙は２０２２年にロシア国内で紙媒体の発行を停止したが、モスクワ中心部の事務所を拠点にオンラインでの情報発信を続けていた。

共同創設者で元編集長のドミトリー・ムラトフ氏は「われわれは、戦争と流血に反対する社会の非常に大きな層の利益を代表している。だからこそ、彼らは今、われわれにこうしたことをしている」と語った。

その上で、「戦争で人々が命を落とし、政治犯が亡くなっている時に、われわれは自分たちのために泣いたりしない。ただ荷物をまとめるだけだ」と述べ、最後の号を制作中だと明らかにした。

ムラトフ氏は２１年のノーベル平和賞を共同受賞した。

ノーバヤ・ガゼータは、旧ソ連最後の指導者ゴルバチョフ氏のノーベル平和賞の賞金を元手に、ゴルバチョフ氏が掲げた「グラスノスチ（情報公開）」の理念に沿って１９９３年に創刊された。

ロシア当局は同紙を、スパイを意味する「外国の代理人」に指定していた。ロシア当局から直ちにコメントは得られなかった。

Brent crude futures for December LCOc1, which expire on Friday, were up US$2.287, or 2.5 per cent, at US$117.75 a barrel as of 1:07pm EDT, after touching a high of US$118. The more active January contract LCOc2 gained US$3.23 to $114.03. US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures CLc1 climbed US$2.74, or 2.7 per cent, to US$104.79. For the month, Brent was on course to finish 13 per cent higher, while WTI was heading for a 15 per cent jump.

It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack . It was the first known successful strike using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull f rom a small boat, in the waterway since the US- Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said. "Continued kinetic action around the Strait of Hormuz amidst doubts of a viable diplomatic pathway is keeping oil prices elevated in expectation of an escalation of the conflict in coming weeks," said Saul Kavonic, head of energy research at MST Marquee. item.title: ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ少なくとも2回必要＝ダラス連銀総裁
item.description:
Ann Saphir
[３０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は３０日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ少なくとも2回必要＝ダラス連銀総裁 3:34 配信

2023年10月9日、米国テキサス州ダラスで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） Ann Saphir

[３０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は３０日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がインフレを抑制するには少なくともあと２回の利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。これは、ウォーシュ議長が５月に就任して以降、米中銀当局者が示した金利指針の中でも最も明確なものの一つだ。

ローガン氏は、ノースカロライナ州デビッドソン大学の学生に向けて準備した講演原稿で「現在の見通しを踏まえると、米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）が少なくともあと２回、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施する必要があることは明確だ」と表明。その上で「その後は、追加の措置が適切かどうかを判断するために、経済・金融情勢を見極める一時停止が理にかなっていると考える」とした。

ローガン氏は今週のＦＯＭＣで、短期金利を現行の３．７５─４．００％のレンジに据え置く決定に賛成票を投じた。決定は１０対２だった。ローガン氏はＦＲＢ政策当局者の中でもタカ派寄りに位置する。

さらにローガン氏は「技術分野の投資見通しや地政学的な動向を巡るニュースを受け、金融市場は不安定な状態が続いている」と指摘。「こうした環境では、政策をより緩やかに調整することで、家計や企業、市場参加者が高い金利に適応しやすくなり、経済活動が必要以上に急激に悪化するリスクを軽減できる」と述べた。

ただしＦＲＢが政策の最終到達点を明確にすることが重要だとも述べた。これは、そうした指針は危機時にのみ示すべきだとするウォーシュ議長の主張とは対照的な見解となる。

長期金利については、最近の上昇はより力強い成長とより高い金利への期待を反映したものだと分析。「市場金利の上昇は、経済活動に対する独立した逆風というよりも、金融政策にはまだやるべきことがあると投資家が考えていることを示すメッセージだ」と語った。今週のＦＯＭＣでの政策据え置きはＦＲＢの最終到達点を変えるものではないとも述べ、「市場参加者がＦＯＭＣの政策方針を理解している限り、各利上げの正確なタイミングは、大半の借り手が支払う長期金利にほとんど影響を与えない」と述べた。

MEXICO CITY, Oct 30 : Formula One champion Lando Norris has a simple view of racing: If a teammate beats him then it means he needs to do a better job. The McLaren driver says also that he always blames himself first, never his equipment. "I don't know what else I'm going to say," the Briton said ahead of a Mexico City Grand Prix that is set to see Mercedes' Italian Kimi Antonelli succeed him as world champion and become the youngest driver, at 20, to take the title. Antonelli has eclipsed his own teammate George Russell with nine wins to three and is 123 points clear of the more experienced Briton, who has had an erratic season of highs and lows.

Mercedes have said the current car does not suit Russell's style while the 28-year-old says he is still searching for answers. NOT DONE A GOOD ENOUGH JOB "If my teammate beats me in a car, I've not done a good enough job," said Norris, last year's winner in Mexico City, when asked about the Mercedes situation, setting out his own philosophy. "I've never blamed my equipment. I always look at myself first, I always blame myself first." Norris said he and teammate Oscar Piastri, who is 67 points behind him in the standings, had found the car difficult to drive in Texas last weekend, but he still blamed himself for not putting together a perfect lap in the final phase of qualifying. "Even though some of it's not my fault because the car was so tricky, I still don't say the only reason I'm not P2 is because the car was tricky. I say because I didn't do a perfect job," he explained. "I can't stand losing to whoever ... so I will have to do whatever I can to be better ... even if the car suits Oscar more than me, I've got to change. I don't know what else you're meant to do. That's my job as a driver." "You need to learn how to adapt to different situations. And I can't speak for the others. Whatever they say is what they say ... the only excuse I would have if I got beat by my teammate is that I've not done a good enough job and the excuse can't be it (the car) doesn't suit me." Norris said that flexibility had been the key to his own success last season, having to adapt when Piastri appeared to be romping away with the title. "I had to change what I was comfy doing. I had to change my expectation, what felt good versus what didn't feel good ... it's not 'my way should be the way'," added Norris. "It's always like - OK, it's a new car. How do I get the most out of it. I've always thought of it that way, not 'my driving style is the best driving style, why is it not doing what I want?'" Russell said on Thursday that there were a "few factors with the cars this year that potentially favour or hinder a certain driving style". He explained that he had always been on the throttle earlier than most on the exit to corners, which was not the most efficient way to drive with the new power units, and higher tyre pressures had also had an impact. "This season I haven't lost it overnight," said Russell. "It's just the hit rate. It's like a baseball player, like hitting a home run or you're missing the ball."

Source: Reuters

BEIJING: China 's first carrier-based stealth reconnaissance and strike drone , the GJ-21, recently completed its first takeoff and landing on the Sichuan, the country's first Type 076 amphibious assault ship, state news agency Xinhua reported on Friday (Oct 30). The trial underscores Beijing's push to integrate drone technology into its military modernisation drive, a decades-long effort in which China has developed advanced warships, fighter jets, missiles and increasingly capable unmanned systems. Xinhua hailed the test as "a breakthrough in China 's amphibious assault ship programme" and said it signifies the navy's ability to operate fixed-wing stealth drone s from large naval platforms. GJ-21 first appeared at a military parade Beijing held last year to mark the 80th anniversary of the end of World War Two, where it displayed different types of weapons.

State tabloid the Global Times reported on Friday that GJ-21 has a substantial combat radius despite having a smaller airframe than the stealth y J-35 and J-20 fighters, citing military expert Zhang Xuefeng. "GJ-21 is also low cost and reusable. Unlike hypersonic missiles, it can be recovered and redeployed multiple times. It can also deploy small, low-cost glide-guided bombs. Under high-tempo operations, it offers greater fire delivery efficiency with better cost control," Zhang was quoted as saying.

The Sichuan, the lead vessel of China 's Type 076 amphibious assault ship class, was launched in December 2024 and features electromagnetic catapult and arresting technology. It can carry fixed-wing drone s, helicopters and amphibious equipment. The vessel has a full-load displacement of more than 40,000 metric tons and features a full-length flight deck and twin-island superstructure. China 's state television CCTV said on Friday that the indigenously developed vessel conducted consecutive sea trials in late October. It did not disclose locations of the trials. China 's navy said in April that the Sichuan sailed to waters in the South China Sea for scientific testing and training missions. It said at the time the deployment was a routine test and did not aim at any specific target.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: 米追加利上げ「近く」必要、インフレ高止まり＝セントルイス連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[３０日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は３０日、高止まりする...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ「近く」必要、インフレ高止まり＝セントルイス連銀総裁 3:16 配信

写真は米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁。2025年5月9日、カリフォルニア州パロアルトで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[３０日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は３０日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、近く利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。

ムサレム総裁は、「シャドー・オープン・マーケット・コミッティー」での講演原稿で、「追加的な金融引き締めが必要であり、それも早急に必要になると判断している」と述べた。

また、「後になって大規模かつ急激な対応を取るよりも、早期に段階的な調整を行う方が通常は混乱が少ない」とし、「インフレ期待が安定している間に、より早い段階で小幅な措置を講じる方が、労働市場や経済成長に悪影響を及ぼすことなく成功する可能性が高い」と語った。

ムサレム氏は、インフレ率が２％目標に比べて依然高過ぎ、上振れリスクが続いていると指摘。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が行動を起こさなければ、インフレが緩和される可能性は低いとの見方を示した。その上で、金融政策は現時点でインフレを押し下げられる状況にないとし、「金融政策と金融環境は依然として緩和的だと考える。金融環境は最近、引き締まった」と述べた。

さらにムサレム氏は講演後、現在の重点課題の一つは、高い物価上昇圧力が経済全体に波及しないようにすることだと説明。「私が現在、特に注力しているのは、インフレのさらなる拡大や、インフレの二次的影響を抑えることだ」と述べ、「住宅を除いたサービス部門のインフレ、コア・サービス・インフレに注目しており、これらの分野における物価上昇圧力が悪化しないよう注視している」と述べた。

ムサレム氏は今年、連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の投票権を持たないが、来年には投票権を得る。

Oct 30 : Alliant Energy expects to sign contracts for about 1 gigawatt of additional data-center demand within six months, its finance chief said on Friday, as rising AI use and growing electrification push US power demand to record highs. The new load would add to the 3.4 GW that Alliant has already contracted with Alphabet's Google, Meta Platforms and Blackstone-backed QTS Data Centers. Earnings growth could exceed the company's 8 per cent target if capital spending rises further to support future load growth and other investment opportunities, Chief Financial Officer Robert Durian said on a post-earnings call. "We continue to work on what I'll call capital upside for different opportunities, including the additional load growth that we may see from the data center prospects that we have," Durian said.

US electricity consumption hit an all-time high in 2025 and is expected to continue rising this year and the next as data-center capacity expands with rapid AI adoption, alongside growing electrification, according to the US Energy Information Administration. The additional 1 GW is expected to begin ramping up between 2029 and 2031, with related investments spread across the company's current planning horizon and beyond, Durian said. Alliant also expects Meta to begin taking transmission service in Wisconsin in the first quarter of 2027, marking an early step in its expanding pipeline of large-load developments. On Thursday, the Madison, Wisconsin-based utility raised its four-year capital expenditure forecast by 19 per cent to $15.9 billion between 2027 and 2030, with peak demand across its system expected to increase by more than 60 per cent by 2031. It also narrowed its 2026 earnings outlook to the upper half of its prior range and issued 2027 guidance of $3.63 to $3.73 per share. The midpoint was in line with Wall Street expectations, according to data compiled by LSEG. Alliant Energy serves roughly 1 million electric and 427,000 natural gas customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission is examining artificial intelligence companies' corporate disclosures as investor worries mount over a potential AI bubble that may have been fueled by circular deals, the agency's enforcement director told Reuters on Friday.  Big Tech stocks sold off this week as companies disclosed they are burning through cash to fuel their AI expansion at a time when interest rates are rising, raising questions about the sustainability of AI spending. David Woodcock, who became SEC enforcement director in May, said the agency does not want to stand in the way of tech innovation, but that it is the agency's job to ensure issuers are giving investors the full picture on potential risks.  "Our principal concern is that people are making accurate disclosures about material information so that investors know what they're getting into," Woodcock said in an interview. "Enforcement is a very necessary piece of making sure people are doing that."

Where such disclosure does not happen, "then enforcement will be present," he said. Woodcock also said that AI and superintelligence have made scams much easier and cheaper to manufacture at scale, raising risks for more and more people. Brokers and other firms need to have processes in place to protect retail investors and "take thoughtful action," he said. PRIVATE MARKETS AND PREDICTION MARKETS Woodcock said the SEC will continue to look at issues in private markets, adding that the enforcement team's asset management unit is very focused on conflicts of interest and valuations. "When people don't make accurate disclosures, whether it's about valuations or whatever, then there is a role for enforcement," Woodcock said. "I think you'll see more activity in this space." Reuters previously reported the SEC was probing a type of private equity fund as part of the agency's broader interest in the opaque markets.  Woodcock said the SEC also has a role in overseeing prediction markets, which allow people to bet on real-world events, including sports, government policy announcements and elections. The markets, led by Polymarket and Kalshi, have surged in popularity over the past two years and have been pushing into US stocks. Such equity-linked prediction markets would traditionally fall under SEC jurisdiction.  Woodcock said the agency's enforcement staff are working with policy officials as well as the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which broadly oversees swap markets, to monitor and regulate the booming new markets. When asked about the possibility of bringing cases against firms that do not register with the agency, Woodcock said the agency does not want to regulate the new industry through enforcement actions.  "We want to be involved where it makes sense, but not in a way that crushes innovation," he said.

Source: Reuters

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 30 : Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca brushed aside questions about the number of red cards players received during his spell at Chelsea after a tense exchange with a reporter on Friday, saying he did not view the issue as a concern. Asked about Chelsea's disciplinary problems at the press conference ahead of Premier League leaders City's clash at home to third-placed Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday, the Italian questioned whether that was before or after his departure. "When I was there or when I left?" asked Maresca, who departed from Chelsea on New Year's Day this year. After the reporter clarified the question related to his tenure, Maresca replied: "You lack information. When I was there... when I left."

Asked if it was an issue, he said: "I don't think so." Six Chelsea players received red cards in just over two months from September to November before Maresca left the club. Chelsea finished on 118 cards in the Premier League last season, six clear of nearest rivals Tottenham Hotspur, and racked up 11 reds in all competitions.  Turning to team news, Maresca said the only City player unavailable to face Brighton was forward Antoine Semenyo. The Italian also expressed satisfaction with progress made during his opening months in charge at City, having rejoined the club at the end of June, saying they were moving in the right direction despite significant changes on and off the pitch. City are top with 21 points from eight matches, above Arsenal on goal difference and five points clear of Brighton. "We're going in the right direction," Maresca said. "I think, in this moment, we are competing, and we changed many players, changed manager. But the good thing about the club is that, in this moment, I think we are competing in all competitions and we know that it takes time." Maresca's first months at the helm have coincided with the club being found guilty of 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules. City have denied any wrongdoing and appealed.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : OpenAI said on Friday it is tightening limits on the weapons-related information ChatGPT provides to teens, even when a question appears harmless, as part of new safeguards aimed at preventing real-world violence. The move comes as AI companies face growing scrutiny over the risks chatbots pose to young users and the companies' role in detecting threats of harm. Here are more details: • OpenAI will restrict practical information on weapons and security systems that could be misused, with the limits applying to teens even when there is no sign of violent intent

Drone strikes on Ethiopia displacement camp kill at least 15, sources say

Reuters

30 October, 2026 11:00 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

NAIROBI, Oct 30 (Reuters) – At least 15 people, several of them children, died in a series of drone strikes that hit a camp for displaced civilians in Ethiopia’s Amhara region, two sources involved in a rescue operation said on Friday.

It was not clear why the camp was targeted or who was behind the attack, but the strikes highlight continuing clashes in the area despite a lull in the heavy fighting that erupted last month between an alliance of rebels from northern Tigray region and the government in Addis Ababa.

“There were around five explosions. Then … we started collecting bodies,” a community representative involved in the burials told Reuters, asking not to be named due to the sensitivity of the issue.

Show Full Article

The representative said they helped bury 13 people at the camp, which is known as Jari 2 and is home to more than 1,700 people who fled previous violence.

Two of the injured later died at a hospital in Hayk, a town 17 km (10 miles) away.

A spokesperson for Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed did not immediately respond to requests for comment. A local official said they were aware of the incident and were helping get medical treatment to 36 people who had been injured.

A man who lost a family member described seeing a drone circling overhead on Wednesday and then returning on Thursday.

“Then finally it hit the camp … three times,” the relative told Reuters. “Their body parts were scattered everywhere. We collected and buried pieces of their body parts.”

NO FIGHTING IN THE AREA WHEN CAMP HIT

A resident of Hayk who was helping provide shelter to survivors also said 15 people had been killed. “Those from the camp are now sheltering in a school,” the resident said.

The dead included five children, according to the two sources involved in the rescue.

The relative of one of the victims said they had seen at least 10 injured children under the aged of five receiving treatment.

All three sources said there had been no fighting in the area when the strike took place, but members of the Amhara Fano National Movement, which is part of the rebel alliance spearheaded by fighters from Tigray, had been nearby.

Government troops have driven back the rebel alliance since their offensive was launched on September 23.

They retook the capital of Tigray region earlier this month and advanced towards the border with Eritrea, which Ethiopia accuses of supporting the rebellion by sending troops over the border.

Eritrea denies the accusation and says Addis Ababa’s allegations of an invasion by Eritrean forces amounted to a “declaration of war”.

Given the web of interconnected conflicts in the Horn of Africa, with neighbouring countries and powers further afield backing their respective proxies, experts have warned that war in Ethiopia could trigger a broader conflict in the region.

(Reporting by Nairobi Newsroom; Writing by David Lewis; Editing by David Holmes and Ros Russell)

item.title: 英ＢＰ、7─9月期純利益は予想上回る 現指標開始以降で最高
item.description:
Stephanie Kelly Shadia Nasralla
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英石油大手のＢＰが...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英ＢＰ、7─9月期純利益は予想上回る　現指標開始以降で最高 2:28 配信

オーストラリア・シドニーにある英BPガソリンスタンド。3月19日撮影。REUTERS/Hollie Adams（ロイター） Stephanie Kelly　Shadia Nasralla

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英石油大手のＢＰが３０日に発表した２０２６年７─９月期（２６年第３・四半期）決算は、純利益に相当する実質再調達原価利益が８４億６０００万ドルと、現指標の採用を始めて以降の四半期ベースで過去最高となった。前年同期の２２億ドル、アナリスト予想の７３億３０００万ドルをいずれも上回った。中東情勢に伴うエネルギー価格高騰や精製マージンの拡大が寄与した。

２９日に四半期決算を発表した英シェルと仏トタルエナジーズも利益が市場予想を上回り、自社株買い計画の拡大を決定した。

ＢＰは、余剰キャッシュの一部について、１０年に起きたメキシコ湾沖の石油掘削施設「ディープウォーター・ホライズン」の原油流出事故に伴う残存債務に充てる方針を示した。

メグ・オニール最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、自社株買い再開や配当増の可能性に関して、現配当を維持するために債務削減に注力すると説明した。オニール氏は声明で、石油・ガスの生産量は日量約２２０万バレルを維持しているとし、「上流部門のプラントの信頼性と精製設備の稼働率は、前四半期に比べていずれも改善し、トレーディング部門の業績も向上した」と言及した。

営業キャッシュフローは１４８億ドル。一方、純負債は１３９億ドルに減少し、目標を１年前倒しで達成した。指標精製マージンは１バレル＝４６．７ドルと、４─６月期の２９．６ドル、前年同期の１５．８ドルから上昇。主に太陽光発電事業や洋上風力発電の関連で４０億ドルの減損を計上した。

ＢＰは、１２月１５日に長期計画に関する最新情報を発表する予定だ。

item.title: Ｇ２０外相、米国務長官が協調促す ロシア参加で溝深まる
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は３０日、アトランタで開かれた２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合の冒頭で、一連の危機が世界の経済秩序に深刻な脅威をもたらしていると警告し、地政学的な安定と経済的な繁栄の拡大に向けて協力するよう呼びかけた。世界はエネルギー・食料供給や貿易、航行の自由を脅かすさまざまな危機に直面していると指摘した上で、「われわれには、それぞれの国を代表し、互いに協力して新たな危機への対応を調整し、共通の利益を守る責務がある。地政学的な安定の拡大と、首脳らが取り組む幅広い経済的繁栄の課題に向けた環境を整えることができる」と語った。

今回の会合は２日間の日程で開かれる。

しかし、会合にロシアのラブロフ外相が参加したことに、多くのＧ２０外相が反発。ウクライナと中東の戦争を巡る深い溝が一段と広がっており、専門家や外交官は会合で実質的な進展が妨げられる可能性があると指摘する。

ラブロフ氏の参加を批判してきたカナダのアナンド外相は、冒頭の全体会合を欠席した。同氏の報道官によると、モントリオールでのカナダ・欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議に出席していたため、到着が遅れているという。

南アフリカの外相も欠席した。２０２６年の議長国である米国が招待しなかった。

欧州の一部当局者がラブロフ氏との写真撮影に応じないと表明したことを受け、恒例のＧ２０集合写真の撮影はルビオ氏の公式日程から外された。西側の外交官によると、オーストラリアとカナダを含む参加者の３分の１が反対した。

ドイツのワーデフール外相は記者団に対し、集合写真の撮影自体が取りやめになるとの見通しを示した。「欧州のパートナーとラブロフ氏が一緒に集合写真に収まることは決してない。２９日に述べたように、ロシアと通常通りに付き合うことはできない」と語った。

米国は、重要鉱物に対する中国の支配に対抗する連携を構築する一方、同盟国の関心を貿易不均衡に向けようとしてきた。しかし、多くのＧ２０加盟国にとって最大の懸念は依然として戦争とその経済的な影響だ。

オバマ政権時代に米国務省のチーフエコノミストを務めたハイジ・クレボレディカー氏は、Ｇ２０加盟国のロシア、中国や、ブラジルやインドなどの中堅国が米中の戦略的競争への対応を模索する中、「これまでにないほど分裂が深まっている」と指摘した。過去１０年余り、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は少なくとも「Ｇ２０に臨む前に共通の方針で合意していたが、今はそれすらできていない」と述べた。

item.title: Spanish minister refuses to resign over second major train crash on his watch
item.description: The crash, which killed at least 69 people, marks the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

World

Spanish minister refuses to resign over second major train crash on his watch

The crash, which killed at least 69 people, marks the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies.

Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente speaks during a press conference to provide details on the deadly train crash near Toledo, in Madrid, Spain, Oct 30, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Juan Barbosa)

31 Oct 2026 01:00AM

FAST

MADRID: Spain's transport minister on Friday (Oct 30) rejected calls for his resignation over the second train accident on his watch to cause mass casualties this year, as authorities worked to identify the victims from a crash that killed at least 69 people. Lawmakers from across the political spectrum this week condemned Transport Minister Oscar Puente for attributing Wednesday's crash to a break in protocol by control centre operators rather than accepting responsibility, with rail workers' unions calling for his immediate dismissal. The crash, which happened near the town of Urda in central Spain, followed another accident involving the same rail companies on the same line that killed 46 people in January. It has reopened a debate about safety and maintenance on Spain's high-speed rail network, the most extensive in Europe, as the country prepares for an election that left-leaning Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has called for Nov 29.

"My duty now is not to focus on discussing whether I will remain in office, but on solving the problem, determining exactly what happened and providing clear explanations," Puente said at a press conference on Friday. At the scene of the crash, large cranes were lifting the mangled wreckage as the Civil Guard listed 64 people as missing in what is already Spain's deadliest train accident since 2013. It was unclear if all those missing were accounted for in the death toll. Authorities have carried out 49 autopsies so far and formally identified five people, three women and two men, Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, said on state television network TVE.

Cranes lift wrecked train carriages as rescuers search for victims following a collision between two trains in Urda, Spain, Thursday, Oct 29, 2026. (Photo: AP/Manu Fernandez)

AUTHORITIES CAN'T RULE OUT MORE FATALITIES No additional bodies were found when rescue teams overturned a train carriage on Thursday, Castilla-La Mancha regional leader Emiliano Garcia-Page said on TVE. Identifying the bodies was proving difficult because many were in pieces, he said. On Thursday, rescue teams had placed partial remains in 31 bags. "We cannot rule out the possibility of more fatalities," Garcia-Page said. The collision occurred after several trains were automatically stopped due to the failure of a signalling system, after which the central control centre in Madrid took over. A train operated by state-owned Renfe was authorised to proceed, even though there was a stationary Iryo-operated train ahead, according to Puente. Audio of communications between the control centre and the train drivers obtained by El Pais showed how a controller authorised the Renfe train to continue on its journey at a normal speed, which Puente said disregarded a protocol to travel at no more than 40 kph in such circumstances.

CONTROLLERS SAY FOCUS SHOULD BE ON FAILED SIGNAL SYSTEM The debate about who was at fault intensified, with unions saying it was unfair to lay the blame on human error. Raquel Ayllon, a union leader at state-owned infrastructure operator Adif, said controllers were having to operate under difficult working conditions. "Human error is being criticised and questioned very quickly, while people are not really focusing on the central issue: the failure of the safety system," Ayllon said on TVE. Puente said the number of staff working at the control centre in Madrid had almost doubled since 2012 and that the controller who made the call had been working for two hours when the crash occurred. "I have never used the term 'human error', although that is not to say that there was no human error," he said. He said the LZB train control system that failed on Wednesday had an average of 170 failures per year, which was about the same as the rest of Europe. The system was behind schedule for an upgrade, public documents show.

Related:

Spain working 'tirelessly' to identify train crash dead: PM

Grieving Spain demands answers for latest rail disaster that killed 69 people

The European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) has been installed across most of Spanish high-speed rail, according to a factsheet by European rail association UNIFE, which developed the new standard. Thales España, the Spanish arm of the French equipment maker, won a 2021 contract to install the ERTMS on the Madrid-Seville line, site of the two fatal crashes, by early 2026, but the work fell behind and passed to Hitachi Rail in 2024, according to Thales. Thales declined to comment on the delay of the rollout. Puente said the ERTMS system on the Madrid-Seville line was expected to begin working in early 2027, adding that the delay was due to the complexity of installing the system while keeping the line in operation.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: Nvidia in talks to give credit support for Nscale's deal with Anthropic
item.description: Nvidia is reportedly considering billions of dollars in credit guarantees to help Nscale finance a West Virginia AI data centre for Anthropic, though the deal has not been finalised.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia is in talks to offer AI cloud provider Nscale billions of dollars in credit guarantees to support debt funding for a data center earmarked for Anthropic, The Information reported on Thursday, citing people with knowledge of the talks. The credit support would help fund power infrastructure and construction of Nscale's AI data centre in West Virginia, which Anthropic plans to use, according to the report. Nvidia is an investor in the UK-based cloud provider. The deal has not been signed and terms could still change, the report said. Nvidia, Nscale and Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Claude maker Anthropic struck a deal in August to spend $45 billion to rent computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus. Nscale is also in talks to sell about 460 megawatts of AI computing power to Anthropic in another deal that could also be worth about $45 billion. The report comes as companies such as CoreWeave and Firmus, which are both backed by Nvidia, have been hit by concerns about debt financing behind the AI build-out.

item.title: Stocks fall on AI cash burn worries while bonds rally with oil
item.description: NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 30 : A sharp selloff in Wall Street's tech shares pushed MSCI's global index down more than 1 per cent on Friday, sending investors to the safety of US bonds on fears that hefty cash-burning AI investments may not deliver sufficient returns. Shares in chipmaker Intel plunged 28 per cent

A trader works on the floor at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, US, October 28, 2026. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

31 Oct 2026 12:46AM (Updated: 31 Oct 2026 12:53AM)

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 30 : A sharp selloff in Wall Street's tech shares pushed MSCI's global index down more than 1 per cent on Friday, sending investors to the safety of US bonds on fears that hefty cash-burning AI investments may not deliver sufficient returns.  Shares in chipmaker Intel plunged 28 per cent and Amazon shares were off 1.9 per cent after their results each showed they burned through cash while investing heavily in AI-related development. Intel also said PC demand had slowed, and that it could persist through next year. Shares in Google parent Alphabet, after falling 12.6 per cent on Thursday, extended losses on Friday. Its massive AI spending turned the company cash flow negative while its search business faced stiff competition. "It's really been a horror show this morning and the real villain is AI spending," said Gene Goldman, chief investment officer at Cetera, saying the heavy cash burn and elevated capex are prompting questions about whether the AI returns will "justify the outlays."

Goldman also said pressure from rising oil prices due to more attacks in the Middle East and concerns about a hack at Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, added to the gloom. Bitcoin and other cryptocurrency prices fell. Outside tech, other sectors were holding up, particularly energy, which rose following results from Exxon Mobil and Chevron. The oil majors posted strong profits due to big refining margins driven by supply disruptions from Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and the US-Israel war on Iran. Shares rose 1.3 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. On Wall Street at 12:09 p.m. ET (1609 GMT), the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 384.61 points, or 0.73 per cent, to 51,957.95, the S&P 500 fell 124.20 points, or 1.61 per cent, to 7,595.93 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 684.06 points, or 2.61 per cent, to 25,500.67.  MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe fell 15.62 points, or 1.4 per cent, to 1,117.00. The pan-European STOXX 600 index fell 0.46 per cent. In currencies, the yen headed for a third daily gain on Friday after the Bank of Japan held rates steady but revised up its inflation forecast, while a fresh wave of selling in AI shares triggered demand for non-dollar safe havens.   The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.03 per cent to 101.85, with the euro down 0.07 per cent at $1.117. Against the Japanese yen, the dollar weakened 0.2 per cent to 157.37. Bitcoin fell 1.80 per cent to $77,424.37.  US Treasuries rose, putting benchmark 10-year yields on track for their biggest monthly decline since late 2023, as the tech-stock selloff pushed investors into safe havens.  The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 4.36 basis points to 4.945 per cent while the 30-year bond yield  fell 0.69 basis points to 5.3221 per cent. The 2-year note yield, which typically moves in step with interest rate expectations for the Federal Reserve, fell 5.4 basis points to 4.602 per cent. Oil prices were on track for a fourth straight monthly gain. Traders are bracing for a potential escalation in the US-Iran conflict after the US midterm elections. The war has lingered for eight months without a resolution, and on Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was attacked, highlighting the ongoing supply risks.  US crude rose 2 per cent to $104.09 a barrel and Brent rose to $117.58 per barrel, up 2.4 per cent on the day. Precious metals fell. Gold dropped to a one-year low on Friday and silver slid below $50 an ounce for the first time since November 2025 as higher energy prices and persistent inflation concerns strengthened expectations that US interest rates will stay high. Spot gold fell 3 per cent to $3,901.83 an ounce. Spot silver fell 5.9 per cent to $49.27 an ounce.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 30 : Former Ireland international and Wrexham captain James McClean is a free agent after parting ways with hometown club Derry City on Wednesday and, though he is not done with soccer, his next sporting appearance may be in boxing rather than football.  The combative 37-year-old, who made his name with Sunderland and West Bromwich Albion and has more than 100 caps, is a boxing fanatic and told Reuters that he wanted to take on British TV star Joey Essex in a bout for the Misfits promotion.  The former Premier League player was speaking to Reuters following the publication of his autobiography, "The Walls".  Known for his direct, no-nonsense style and competitive fire as a footballer, McClean has boxed for years as part of a daily training schedule that keeps him fit physically and mentally. He is relishing the chance to test his skills in the ring.

"Sparring is great, pads are great, bags are great, but there's only one way to find out (how good I am), and that's stepping in the ring," he said.  "Boxing's new to me, so of course there's something I want to prove for myself because it's not something that I've excelled at before ... if that is what's next then, obviously, it's exciting." Having devoted his life to football, McClean is well aware that he does not have the time to start at the bottom of the boxing ladder and work his way up. The recent surge in "influencer boxing", where everyone from high-profile social media figures to reality TV stars meet in the ring, means it is an attractive option.  "I'm almost 38 soon so for me to start a professional boxing career and go down that route, starting from scratch, it's just not plausible, given my age and having to do that," he said. "It (influencer boxing) gives you the opportunity to fight people who aren't pro boxers and they make a decent earning on a couple of fights that probably most professional fighters never make throughout their whole career." McClean has already been in the celebrity spotlight. After he moved to Wrexham, owned by Hollywood stars Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds, McClean featured in the reality TV series "Welcome to Wrexham" as the Welsh club won successive promotions to the second-tier Championship. "If I never kick a ball again, that's where I'll see the ending of my football career. And what a way to go - I'm from Derry but I actually see that club, because of the bond that we had, as kind of my adopted home, it's unbelievable," he said. McClean returned to Derry City in January after leaving Wrexham but the termination of his contract by mutual consent means he might make that ring walk sooner rather than later.  "I'm happy now in the last 24 hours because I'm a free man, and for the first time in 20 years, I'm excited about what's next because I can decide what I want to do, and I'm not tied to football or anything else," he added.

FAST

LONDON, Oct 30 : Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said teenager Max Dowman must learn to cope with the demands of elite football after the winger's red card in the League Cup defeat at fourth-tier Fleetwood Town, with the 16-year-old having to serve a three-match suspension. Dowman, who will miss Sunday's Premier League trip to Liverpool, was sent off in the 85th minute of Tuesday's fourth-round loss after an altercation with defender Harrison Neal as Arsenal lost 5-3 on penalties following a 1-1 draw. "This is the environment, this is the reality. We are not in Disneyland, we are in the Premier League," Arteta told a press conference on Friday following criticism from football fans over his reaction to Dowman after the red card. Arteta gave the teenager a stern look as he left the pitch at Fleetwood's Highbury Stadium and exchanged words with Dowman on his way down the tunnel, later saying that the issue was something the pair had spoken about before kickoff.

"We look after him so much but at the same time we're going to demand from him like everybody else because he needs to earn the right to play. Because the other boys, what are they going to say to me? You need to be fair," Arteta said. Arteta said his response was driven by frustration over the consequences for Dowman, adding that the teenager's profile meant he was likely to attract attention from opponents. He dismissed any suggestion of a rift with the winger. "There are no issues. We had a talk yesterday. I have done it. That's why I am so protective of these things, especially with young players because we have made these mistakes and you know how much you can get punished and how much it can change what happens next," Arteta said. The Spaniard also voiced his disappointment after an independent regulatory commission upheld Dowman's ban, rejecting Arsenal's appeal against the dismissal and punishment. "Very disappointed, to be fair, especially with the reckless tackle that he received. His reaction is minimal compared to the action," he said of Neal's challenge on Dowman. RICE AND CALAFIORI BACK IN TRAINING On the injury front, Arteta said midfielder Declan Rice and defender Riccardo Calafiori had resumed training after missing the Fleetwood match with issues suffered in last weekend's home win over Everton in the Premier League. Bukayo Saka, however, remains sidelined with the thigh problem he picked up in the Champions League draw at Bayern Munich on October 21. "He needed another scan to see how much of the fluid has resolved. Afterwards we'll know more about it," Arteta added. He also spoke about facing his former teammate Andoni Iraola's side in a "big game" as Arsenal look to claim their first win against Liverpool at Anfield since September 2012. The two managers are from the Basque region and played together for youth team Antiguoko in San Sebastien. "It’s a privilege. Someone who has been your teammate, that you spent so many beautiful moments together when we were younger. To be facing each other, to be close, massive clubs in this country, in Europe, in a big match like this, it’s a blessing," he said. Champions Arsenal are second behind Manchester City on goal difference with 21 points from eight games, six points ahead of fourth-placed Liverpool. "We expect a big game on Sunday; we’re looking forward to it for sure. It’s been 14 years since we last won there, so it’s time to do it," added Arteta.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 30 : Liverpool coach Andoni Iraola refused to let a five-match winning run go to his team's head on Friday, saying it was too early to discuss a Premier League title challenge before champions Arsenal visit Anfield on Sunday. After a humbling 3-0 defeat by Manchester City this month, Iraola's side have won five straight games across three competitions, including Wednesday's penalty shootout victory over Chelsea to reach the League Cup quarter-finals. Fourth-placed Liverpool are six points behind Arsenal. "It's still October, take one game at a time and I always say the first reference is normally when we have played against each other once, halfway through the season, and then you can start looking at the standings," Iraola told reporters.

"Now we are in a position where we need to improve, keep getting better. Can fans dream? It's good if they have expectations and think we can win. But if you ask me, it is still early." GOOD RECORD AGAINST ARSENAL  Iraola has a good record against Arsenal having won three of his last four meetings with Mikel Arteta's side as Bournemouth head coach. With Arsenal chasing a first win at Anfield since 2012, the Spaniard said past records would count for little. "It is true we had good results against them with Bournemouth but it does not mean a lot as it is a totally different team, different group of players, different moments," he said. "At the end of the day it is about winning the duels, running more than them, winning the aerial duels, set plays, mini games, these things that you have to control against Arsenal. They are the champions, they are top of the league right now, they have only lost one game this season." Sunday's match offers Iraola the chance to meet up with his former teammate Arteta after they came through the youth ranks together in San Sebastian in Spain's Basque Country. "Last week was (Chelsea boss) Xabi (Alonso), now Mikel, a lot of former friends on the opposition bench lately. I think it is a good thing in terms of spending 5-10 minutes after the game normally with them," Iraola said. Dominik Szoboszlai (hamstring) and Victor Munoz (knee) could feature after recovering from injuries.

item.title: 独ＶＷ、主力ＥＶの開発を一時停止 コスト削減が影響
item.description:
Christina Amann Rachel More
[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ロイターが３０日に入手した...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独ＶＷ、主力ＥＶの開発を一時停止　コスト削減が影響 1:00 配信

2020年2月18日撮影。REUTERS/Chris Helgren（ロイター） Christina Amann　Rachel More

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ロイターが３０日に入手したメモによると、事業再編を進める独自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は、完全電気自動車（ＥＶ）「Ｇｏｌｆ（ゴルフ）」の開発を一時停止する。コスト削減が、本社にある工場で開発中の将来の主力モデルの一つに及んだ形だ。

ブランドの責任者であるトーマス・シェーファー氏は「決定は容易なものではなかった」とした上で、「現時点で開発に資金を充てる余裕がない」と説明した。

当初の発売目標から既に遅れているものの、ロイターが確認した別のメールによると、開発の一時停止による発売の遅れはないという。

ＶＷは１０万人の人員削減やドイツ内の最大４カ所の工場閉鎖を進めている。２０２６年７─９月期決算で営業損失は過去１０年余りで最も大きかった。

メモによると、ニーダーザクセン州にある本社の工場は、コスト削減目標に対し３億ユーロ（３億３６００万ドル）が不足。工場閉鎖の対象ではないものの、ドイツでの事業に対してコスト削減圧力が強まっている。

産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルとの緊張が高まっており、年明けにスト入りの可能性がある。ＶＷ傘下のアウディによる４０億ドル規模の米国での工場建設計画が、監査役会の承認前にトランプ米大統領参加の集会で発表されたことにも反発が起きていた。

ロイター 関連リンク コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：ルノー、ＥＶ新会社ＩＰＯ中止は「災い転じて福」か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか 焦点：中国の省エネシフト加速、燃料需要が急減　ＥＶ普及など 10/31(土) 1:00 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ロシア支配下のオレシュキに支援車両到着、住民の退避開始 局地停戦下
item.description:
Dan Peleschuk
[キーウ ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Dan Peleschuk

[キーウ　３０日　ロイター] - ロシア支配下にあるウクライナ南部オレシュキに３０日、食料や医薬品などの支援物資を積んだ車両が到着し、ロシア・ウクライナの共同救援活動の一環として、一部の住民の退避が認められた。

ウクライナのデービッド・アラハミア議員の投稿によると、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人が仲介した局地的停戦の下、支援物資を積んだ車列がオレシュキに到着し、一部の住民はウクライナ支配地域を目指してロシア南部アナパに向けて出発したという。同氏によると、住民はその後ベラルーシに空路で移動し、バスでウクライナに戻るという。

こうした取り組みは、開戦から４年８カ月で初めてとなる。ただ、ロシアのプーチン大統領の報道官は、これを和平に向けた広範な取り組みに「当てはめるのは難しい」との見方を示した。

これに先立ち、ロシア紙イズベスチヤは３０日、オレシュキに向け、食料や医薬品などの支援物資を積んだ車両が夜間に出発したと報じていた。

ただ、他の地域では依然として攻撃が続いており、当局者によると、ウクライナの７つの地域のほか首都キーウや東部ドニプロがロシアの夜間攻撃の標的となった。２９日にはドニプロの鉄道駅へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で少なくとも１５人が死亡した。

FAST

Oct 30 : Meta Platforms has settled with a teen plaintiff who accused the company of designing Instagram and Facebook to be addictive, causing her mental health problems and disordered eating, attorneys for the plaintiff said on Friday. The settlement came after jury selection began on Wednesday for a trial that was slated to test the claims of two teens, identified as S.J. and K.D.B., against Meta and Snapchat parent Snap Inc. Meta had settled with S.J. days before the trial, so Friday's settlement with K.D.B. means the trial is expected to proceed against Snap only. “We remain committed to improving safety for kids on social media apps and holding tech companies accountable, and we are pleased to have brought this matter to a just resolution on behalf of our client,” Emily Jeffcott, an attorney for K.D.B., said in a statement. A spokesperson for Meta said settlements, dismissals and trials are part of the process of testing cases like this.

"We will continue to defend ourselves in court, and we stand by our record," the spokesperson said, noting that Meta has been building safety tools for more than a decade. A spokesperson for Snap did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The trial is the second in Los Angeles state court over claims brought by young people who say they became addicted to social media after Meta, Snap, TikTok and Alphabet's YouTube designed their platforms to encourage compulsive use. S.J. and K.D.B. had previously settled with TikTok and YouTube. The case was selected among the thousands of pending lawsuits as a test case, so the jury's verdict could influence how the companies and plaintiffs resolve similar cases. S.J., a 16-year-old girl from Illinois, and K.D.B., an 18-year-old from Mississippi, say they began using YouTube as early as age 3 and the other platforms around age 9, developing compulsive habits they blame on features such as autoplay and infinite scroll.  The companies have rejected claims their platforms were designed to addict young people, and say they have taken action to make the apps safe places for young people to express themselves.  Social media companies face thousands of lawsuits in federal and state courts by individuals, school districts, municipalities and other government entities alleging the companies knowingly sought to addict children to their platforms, contributing to a youth mental health crisis involving anxiety, depression and suicide.  In the first case to go to trial, which ended in March, a Los Angeles jury found Meta and YouTube had been negligent and awarded a young woman $6 million in damages. The next two teens whose cases were selected for trials either settled or dropped their claims against the companies. The first school district chosen for trial settled with all of the companies. In August, Meta struck settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every state and US territory to resolve lawsuits brought by attorneys general over the platforms’ harm to teens and agreed to make changes to how Instagram and Facebook work for teens. Earlier this month, a New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled Facebook users about the privacy of their data and how it handles hate speech. The company has said it will appeal.

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : Daniil Medvedev secured a place at the season-ending ATP Finals for the seventh time after overwhelming Adrian Mannarino 6-2 6-3 to reach the Vienna Open semi-finals on Friday. The 30-year-old Russian, who missed out on the season finale last year after qualifying every year from 2019 to 2024, joined Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton in the eight-man field. Jannik Sinner has also qualified but will not compete due to injury, leaving four places still available. Medvedev has enjoyed a resurgent season in which he has surpassed the 50-win mark for the first time since 2023 and claimed four titles.

The former U.S. Open champion broke again at 3-3 in the second set and closed out the match with another break. Medvedev will next face Alcaraz, who defeated Tommy Paul 6-4 7-6(2). World number one Alexander Zverev thumped Britain's Arthur Fery 6-0 6-2 in 58 minutes to reach the semi-finals. Fery, who received treatment from the physio in the closing stages of his second-round win against Lorenzo Musetti on Thursday, appeared to be physically hindered from the first game against Zverev. The German will next face either Italy's Matteo Berrettini or Australian fifth seed Alex de Minaur.

item.description: Oct 30 : The biggest US technology companies generated record amounts of cash in the first nine months of 2026, yet returned the smallest share of it to shareholders in at least 15 years as surging artificial intelligence spending squeezed share buybacks.The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support

Big Tech returns smallest share of cash to shareholders in 15 years, given AI spending

FAST

Oct 30 : The biggest US technology companies generated record amounts of cash in the first nine months of 2026, yet returned the smallest share of it to shareholders in at least 15 years as surging artificial intelligence spending squeezed share buybacks. The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support for technology share prices. With companies buying back fewer shares, investors are increasingly dependent on heavy AI investments delivering enough profit growth to justify their valuations. Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned 9.3 per cent of the cash their businesses generated as dividends and buybacks in the first three quarters of the year, down from 27.4 per cent a year earlier, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data and companies' financial reports showed. Operating cash flow actually rose 29 per cent from a year earlier to a record $542.9 billion.

But capital spending, driven by the AI boom, doubled to $556.9 billion, exceeding the cash the five firms generated for the first time in data going back to 2011. That left them with a combined free cash flow deficit of $14 billion, against a surplus of $143.5 billion a year earlier. The squeeze has hit buybacks hardest. The five companies cut repurchases 83 per cent to $13.6 billion, from $81.8 billion a year earlier. BUYBACKS FIRST TO GO Dividends, which investors treat as a commitment, rose to $37 billion in the first nine months of 2026 from $33.9 billion a year earlier. Buybacks almost disappeared. Alphabet and Meta have not repurchased a share in 2026, after buying back $66.5 billion in the first nine months of last year. Amazon pays no dividend and has not bought back shares since 2022. Microsoft accounted for nearly all the five companies’ remaining repurchases, and cut its buybacks to $4.4 billion in the September quarter from $5.7 billion a year earlier. Some companies are no longer covering their payouts from what their businesses earn after capital spending. With combined free cash flow (FCF) negative, the five companies’ $50.6 billion in payouts was effectively funded from cash reserves, borrowing or share sales. Amazon’s capital spending of $75.9 billion in the third quarter was almost 80 per cent more than the $42.4 billion its operations generated, and it raised $48.1 billion of long-term debt in the quarter. Alphabet’s free cash flow was also negative, and it raised about $12.4 billion from share sales and $29 billion from debt. THE HIDDEN COST The loss of buybacks matters more than the dollar figures suggest, because buybacks have flattered per-share earnings for years. When companies buy back and retire their own shares, profits are spread across fewer shares, lifting earnings per share even when total profits do not grow. Alphabet reduced its share count by 9.5 per cent between the end of 2020 and 2025 through buybacks, ING said. That alone provided a boost of roughly 2 per cent a year to earnings per share (EPS), even without any increase in profits. Without that boost, per-share earnings must come from actual profit growth. That is a harder test, and it arrives just as depreciation charges on new data centres start to rise. It also lands where investors are most sensitive. Investors care “so much more about EPS than FCF,” Mark Schilsky, a technology sector specialist at JPMorgan, said in a client note last week. Technology and communication services stocks, which account for about 43.5 per cent of US market value, delivered a shareholder yield of just 0.28 per cent in July, against 1.99 per cent for the rest of the market, MSCI found. NO END IN SIGHT Amazon said it still expects about $220 billion of capital spending this year, and the other companies have signalled further increases. That leaves Big Tech shareholders with a different bargain from the one they signed up for, accepting less cash today in exchange for a bet that AI will eventually generate enough profit to make up for it. "For the last 15 years, companies increasingly returned excess capital to shareholders through buybacks and dividends," said Ehren Stanhope, co-head of investment management at Franklin Templeton. "The current regime may increasingly be characterized by greater equity and debt issuance, a request of capital from investors."

(Reporting By Patturaja Murugaboopathy, Editing by Vidya Ranganathan and Nia Williams)

Source: Reuters

Oct 30 : US forward Christian Pulisic has signed a contract extension with AC Milan through 2031, the Serie A club said on Friday.  The 28-year-old had spells at Borussia Dortmund and Chelsea before joining Milan in 2023. The American has recorded 44 goals in 141 appearances for the Rossoneri and finished the 2024-25 season as their top scorer.  "Pulisic's contract extension reflects a shared commitment to building on the progress made together in recent years, with the ambition to keep improving, achieve new milestones and write more memorable chapters in the Club's history," Milan said in a statement.  Pulisic has represented his country at two World Cups and is a four-times winner of the U.S. Soccer Male Player of the Year.

(Corrects designation of John Bilton in paragraph 8) By Johann M Cherian and Shashwat Chauhan Oct 30 : More than $2 trillion in market value is set to be wiped from the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 this month, as Big Tech earnings intensified investor scrutiny of whether the billions being poured into artificial intelligence can generate returns quickly enough. The wipeout would amount to slightly more than SpaceX’s entire market value. The index has fallen over 5.8 per cent so far in October as the AI trade ran into turbulence, with hyperscalers Meta Platforms, Alphabet and Amazon.com raising spending forecasts further as they race to expand AI infrastructure.

The prospect of ever-bigger AI outlays has unnerved investors, particularly as rising borrowing costs threaten to make debt-funded investment more expensive and harder to justify. Here's a roundup of megacap earnings so far, with Apple set to report next week and AI bellwether Nvidia due mid-November. TECH WIPEOUT Alphabet suffered its biggest one-day percentage drop on record on Thursday after disappointing results in the core business of search advertising and a massive acceleration in cash burn. Meta's plans for a record $97.5 billion fund raise heightened concerns about shareholder dilution and whether mounting AI spending could force other Big Tech companies to increasingly tap capital markets. Microsoft and SpaceX broke from the gloom, with results that showed AI spending starting to pay off. "It may be that we've overestimated how strong the growth might be, but they're not going negative in aggregate," said John Bilton, global head of strategic research, multi-asset solutions at JPMorgan Asset Management. "We have an insatiable and growing demand for data." RISING DEBT PILE Microsoft is reportedly planning to raise about $25 billion through its first US investment-grade bond sale in more than nine years. Among other hyperscalers, Meta, Amazon and Alphabet have issued hundreds of billions of dollars in bond sales over the past four years, worrying investors about overreliance on the medium for raising capital. Morgan Stanley forecast capital spending on AI infrastructure overall will surpass a trillion dollars next year. COST TO INSURE AGAINST DEBT DEFAULT SURGE AI companies’ growing reliance on debt funding is emerging as a new risk for investors, challenging the view that the companies at the heart of the boom are insulated from macroeconomic pressures. The concern is spreading beyond stocks to credit markets, where investors are starting to price in the possibility that rising financing costs, combined with slower returns on AI spending, could squeeze companies previously viewed as relatively insulated. ROBUST REVENUE Revenue across the "Magnificent Seven" has remained strong since ChatGPT's launch in 2022, showcasing insatiable demand and perhaps why investors were initially willing to back the spending, even as the timeline of payoffs remains uncertain. Amazon's cloud computing cash cow, Amazon Web Services, continued to accelerate, while Meta offered better-than-expected revenue growth and an upbeat outlook. Microsoft also forecast strong cloud growth in its latest earnings report. SOARING CAPEX Big Tech has historically spent heavily on infrastructure to build and expand businesses such as cloud computing, online advertising and e-commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditure to dizzying levels. J.P. Morgan expects global AI capex to reach $5.5 trillion by 2030, and sees $900 billion being spent in 2026 alone. This year's AI capex by Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and Microsoft would likely equal their cumulative spend since the November 2022 launch of ChatGPT, J.P. Morgan analysts noted.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米金融政策の方向性は「明快」、問題はペース＝リッチモンド連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は３０日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米金融政策の方向性は「明快」、問題はペース＝リッチモンド連銀総裁 10/30 23:49 配信

2026年4月14日、米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁。REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は３０日、インフレ率が高く経済が堅調な中、金融政策の方向性は「明確」だが、今後利上げを進めるペースは未確定との認識を示した。

バーキン総裁はシリウスＸＭの番組「ビジネス・ブリーフィング」で、ＦＲＢが再び利上げする必要があるかどうかを問われ、「インフレは高く、需要は堅調で、失業率は比較的低い。だから、方向性はかなり単純明快だと思う」と応じた。

その上で「問われるのは、ペースだ。われわれは段階的なアプローチを示唆した。カーブにそれほど遅れておらず、見極める時間を確保したい場合には、段階的な対応が理にかなう」と述べた。

現時点では、担当する大西洋岸中部・南東部地区の企業がコスト圧力の高まりと、そのコストを転嫁する意向の両方を報告しているとし、ＡＩ（人工知能）投資の活況が需要と幅広い品目の価格を押し上げていると指摘。ディーゼル燃料から半導体、熟練労働者の賃金に至るまで「多くのコスト圧力が米企業を襲っている。４─５年にわたるインフレ高進という状況の中で、（値上げの）主張はしやすくなっていると思う」と述べた。

その上で「こうしたインフレの実体験は、ＦＲＢが当然何らかの手を打たない限り、将来のインフレに影響を及ぼす」と語った。

ＦＲＢは今週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）金利を据え置いたが、新たな政策声明で「より多くの情報の蓄積」が政策の道筋を判断する助けになるとした。多くのアナリストはこの新たな文言を、今後の利上げを示唆するシグナルと受け止めた。インフレは多くの政策当局者の予想より根強く、予想外の鈍化がない限り利上げに向かうとの見方だ。

次の一手は早ければ１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣで打たれる可能性があり、市場はＦＲＢが追加の０．２５％ポイント利上げを承認すると予想している。

バーキン総裁は２０２６年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持たないが、２０２７年には投票権を得る。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 10/31(土) 0:12 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー3隻炎上、「無許可」航路通過中 ＩＲＧＣが発表
item.description: [３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[３０日 ロイター] - イランの精鋭部隊「イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）」の海軍は３０日、ホルムズ海峡で「無許可の航路」を通過しようとした石油タンカー３隻が火災を起こし、爆発したと発表した。イラン国営メディアが報じた。

ＩＲＧＣ海軍は声明で、タンカー３隻のうち１隻は原油２００万バレルを積載しており、機雷に接触したと説明した。

イランはまた、ホルムズ海峡東部で米国の無人船を破壊したと表明した。米軍から即時の確認は得られておらず、ロイターも独自にこの報告を検証できなかった。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 30 : While dinosaurs ate a lot of different things, including each other, fruit long seemed to have been absent from their menu. But scientists now have found fossils of a turkey-sized and toothless dinosaur possessing a parrot-like head that exhibited multiple adaptations for a specialized fruit diet. This first-known frugivorous dinosaur, named Infernogallus jamesi, lived about 66 million years ago during the Cretaceous Period at the twilight of the age of dinosaurs and displayed traits on its beak and jaws for mashing soft food like fruit. It is known from fossils unearthed in Montana and North Dakota. The name Infernogallus means "hell chicken," a nod to its bird-like appearance and the fact that its fossils were found in the Hell Creek rock formation, which spans the US states of Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wyoming and has yielded the remains of some of the most famous dinosaurs. It would have eaten fruit and other soft plants in the subtropical coastal floodplain ecosystem it shared with the likes of apex predator Tyrannosaurus, three-horned herbivore Triceratops and tank-like armored plant-eater Ankylosaurus.

Infernogallus was about 5 feet (1.5 meters) long and weighed around 25 pounds (11.3 kg). While the fossils — one nearly complete skeleton and isolated bones from a jaw and palate — did not reveal feathers, the researchers believe Infernogallus was covered in them, based on fossils of close relatives. It belonged to a group called theropods that includes T. rex and all the meat-eating dinosaurs, as well as some that took to eating plants and the entire bird lineage. "This definitely expands the range of lifestyles we thought dinosaurs had, and it shows how adaptable theropods were," said paleontologist Greg Funston of Stony Brook University in New York, lead author of the research published in the journal Nature Communications. Fruits are the reproductive structures of angiosperms, also called flowering plants. Angiosperms first appeared earlier in the Cretaceous, around 130 to 140 million years ago, and subsequently took over landscapes previously dominated by plants called gymnosperms like conifers and ginkgoes. Infernogallus shows that some dinosaurs may have had a close ecological relationship with flowering plants. "It has been proposed before that some groups of dinosaurs ate fruits, but there was never evidence to back it up," said study co-author Thomas Dudgeon, a postdoctoral researcher at the Royal Ontario Museum in Toronto. "The discovery of Infernogallus shows that dinosaur diets were likely far more diverse than we previously thought. Prior to this discovery, there was a bit of a mystery in dinosaur evolution. The evolution of flowering plants introduced a brand-new food source that undoubtedly had consequences for the animals living alongside them," Dudgeon said. The fruit available for Infernogallus may have included various berries as well as drupes, a broad category that today includes types with a central pit like peaches and cherries as well as others like mangoes and olives. THREE KEY FEATURES Infernogallus showed a range of features indicating a frugivorous diet. The three most important, Funston said, were the organization of jaw muscles that powered back-and-forth chewing motions, a mobile joint that enabled the jaw to slide forward, and a series of ridges and grooves on the beak to help mash and shear soft plants like fruits. "We see these features separately in birds and turtles today that eat soft foods, like the fig-eating vulturine parrot or green sea turtles that chew soft sea grass. But no living animal has all three adaptations, showing just how specialized Infernogallus was," Funston said. Infernogallus also shows how adaptable beaks are compared to teeth. "Once you've lost your teeth and developed a beak instead, the range of foods available dramatically increases, including plants, as long as you have some way to digest them," Funston said. Most herbivorous theropods used stomach stones called gastroliths to grind food. But Infernogallus and other members of a lineage called caenagnathids chewed their food instead. Fruit-eating animals play an important role for angiosperms by dispersing seeds. "Mammals and birds would probably also have eaten fruit, but they didn't show the same kinds of specializations for a frugivorous diet that Infernogallus does, so it might have been a less important resource for them. Mammals and birds also were quite small in the Cretaceous, so it's unlikely that they were spreading very large seeds, or that they were spreading them big distances," Funston said. "We know that these big-seeded fruits were proliferating and spreading, and it seems like caenagnathids could have fit this role — although we feel more evidence is needed before drawing that link confidently," Funston said.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・序盤＝ナスダック2カ月超ぶり安値、ＡＩインフラ投資巡り懸念 10/30 23:16 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で26日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [３０日 ロイター] - ３０日の米国株式市場はハイテク株中心のナスダック総合が２カ月超ぶりの安値で寄り付いた。アマゾン・ドット・コムの積極的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資計画や、半導体大手インテルが示したキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを受け、ＡＩインフラ構築のコスト膨張とその投資回収時期を巡る懸念が強まった。

ナスダック総合は２．２６％下落。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種も１．１６％安となった。一方、ダウ工業株３０種は０．０８％の小幅高で推移した。

アマゾンが２９日発表した第３・四半期決算は、クラウド事業の成長加速が続いた一方、ＡＩ需要の取り込みに向けた積極投資を背景に現金流出が膨らんだ。２０２７年の設備投資が２６年からさらに増加するとの見通しも示した。

インテルも２９日、パソコン（ＰＣ）市場の低迷や生産上の制約、生産能力拡大への多額の投資により、２６年のキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを示した。

Oct 30 : Tencent-backed Kuaishou Technology said on Friday that its unit Beijing Kling has completed a fundraising round of about 19.8 billion yuan ($2.98 billion). The short-video platform operator will hold two-thirds of the equity and 52.45 per cent of voting rights in the Kling AI maker through its Lucky Labs holding vehicle. • The fundraise comes after a $2.8 billion raise in July, which drew investors like Alibaba and Tencent, when Kling was valued at $15 billion pre-money • Kuaishou did not reveal how Kling would use the proceeds

item.description: [ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が３０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）速報値は、欧州連...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独インフレ率、10月は前年比2.8％に鈍化　伸びは予想下回る 10/30 22:59 配信

ドイツ・フランクフルトで2021年4月撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach（ロイター） [ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が３０日発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）速報値は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年比２．８％上昇した。伸びは９月（３．３％上昇）から鈍化し、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想（３．１％上昇）も下回った。

エネルギー価格の上昇率が１２．２％と、９月の１４．９％から鈍化したことが背景にある。１０月初めに導入され、年末まで維持される予定の燃料税軽減策が、燃料価格の緩やかな下落につながっている。

価格変動の大きいエネルギーと食品を除いたコアインフレ率は２．１％上昇と、９月の２．４％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。

ユーロ圏の１０月インフレ率は１１月４日に発表される。ロイター調査によるエコノミスト予想では、前月の３．８％から３．９％に小幅加速する見通し。

item.title: 米雇用コスト、第3四半期は前期比0.8％上昇 予想と一致
item.description: [ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が３０日に発表した２０２６年第３・四半期の雇用コスト指数（ＥＣＩ）は前期...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米雇用コスト、第3四半期は前期比0.8％上昇　予想と一致 10/30 22:36 配信

米マサチューセッツ州メドフォードにあるレストランの窓に掲げられた求人看板。2023年1月撮影。REUTERS/Brian Snyder（ロイター） [ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米労働省が３０日に発表した２０２６年第３・四半期の雇用コスト指数（ＥＣＩ）は前期比で０．８％上昇し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想と一致した。賃金の伸び鈍化を背景に第２・四半期の０．９％上昇から鈍化し、労働市場がインフレリスクになる公算が小さいことを示唆した。

第３・四半期は前年同期比で３．４％上昇と、前期と同じ伸びとなった。

労働コストの大部分を占める賃金・給与は０．７％上昇と、前期の０．９％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。前年同期比でも３．１％上昇と、前期の３．２％上昇から鈍化した。インフレ調整後では前年同期比０．６％低下した。前期は０．３％低下していた。

民間部門の賃金・給与は０．８％上昇と、前期の０．９％上昇から伸びが鈍化した。前年同期比では３．１％上昇した。

公的部門（州・地方自治体）の賃金・給与は０．６％上昇。前期は０．９％上昇していた。前年同期比では３．２％上昇した。

全労働者の福利厚生費は０．９％上昇と、前期の１．０％上昇から小幅鈍化。公的部門の伸びが０．７％上昇と、前期の１．１％上昇から減速したことが抑制の要因となった。民間部門は０．９％上昇と、前期と同じ伸びとなった。福利厚生費全体では前年同期比３．９％上昇した。

ＢＭＯキャピタル・マーケッツのシニアエコノミスト、プリシラ・ティアガムーシー氏は「労働コストのインフレは正しい方向に進み続けている」と指摘。「消費者物価は依然として高止まりしているが、労働市場がもはや物価上昇圧力の大きな要因ではなくなったという事実は、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）にとって幾分の安心材料となるだろう」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 アングル：試される米消費の持続力、物価高に政府閉鎖や雇用情勢悪化で 10/31(土) 0:25 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＥＣＢ当局者、追加利上げの可能性指摘 物価・賃金上昇を警戒
item.description: [フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）当局者は３０日、高インフレの抑制と賃金・物価の相互加速を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ当局者、追加利上げの可能性指摘　物価・賃金上昇を警戒 10/30 21:22 配信

パネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁、5月18日撮影 REUTERS/Tom Nicholson（ロイター） [フランクフルト ３０日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）当局者は３０日、高インフレの抑制と賃金・物価の相互加速を防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＥＣＢは前日の理事会で利上げを議論したが、エネルギー価格主導のインフレ急進が危険な二次的波及効果をまだ生んでいないとの判断に基づき、最終的に全会一致で据え置きを決めた。

３０日の当局者発言からは、利上げが先送りされたにすぎず、１２月の利上げがあり得ることを示した。

イタリア中央銀行のパネッタ総裁はローマで「物価上昇が家計や企業の期待や行動に定着して食い止めに代償を伴う賃金と物価の上昇スパイラルを引き起こすことを、金融政策は防ぐことができ、また防ぐべきだ」と指摘。「インフレ率が長期にわたり目標を上回る見通しで、リスクも上振れ方向にあることから、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場は１２月の利上げ確率を約３分の２と見込んでいる。２０２６年にすでに実施された２回の利上げに加え、今後１年間に３回近くの利上げを予想している。

オーストリア中央銀行のコッハー総裁も３０日のブログ投稿でパネッタ氏と同様の見解を示し、「近い将来に状況が改善しなければ、金融政策を取り巻く環境からみて対応が必要になるだろう」と記し、「インフレリスクは明らかに高まった。ただ、時期尚早な行動も、何もせずに待つことも、物価安定を確保することにはならない」とした。

ユーロ圏の９月インフレ率は３．８％と、ＥＣＢの目標のほぼ２倍に達した。エネルギーコストの再急騰と食品価格の上昇により、今後数カ月に一段と加速する可能性がある。

ＥＣＢが３０日に公表した調査によると、インフレ率は２６・２７年に従来予想を上回るペースで加速し、目標に戻るのは２８年になる可能性がある。

エストニア中央銀行のカーシク総裁は「物価上昇が予想よりも速く、長期にわたって続くリスクは依然として大きい」と指摘。「したがって、金融市場がＥＣＢの追加利上げを見込んでいることは理解できる」と語った。

一方、パネッタ氏は慎重な姿勢も示し、ＥＣＢは「金融政策を段階的に調整する」際、最近の債券利回りの急上昇がすでに借り入れコストを押し上げていることを考慮すべきだと述べた。

FAST

SINGAPORE: Hackers stole US$6.3 billion from Binance , the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, in a record digital asset theft. WHAT HAPPENED? About US$6.3 billion of cryptocurrencies were drained from wallets that Binance uses to process transactions, according to the exchange and expert analysis of blockchain records. Binance said in a statement on X that it initially thought the attack involved a compromised laptop.

"However, our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach," it added, without elaborating. The exchange operates a secure asset fund for users, a US$1 billion bitcoin reserve designed to protect customers in the event of a security breach, according to its website.

Subscribe to our Chief Editor’s Week in Review

Our chief editor shares analysis and picks of the week's biggest news every Saturday.

This service is not intended for persons residing in the E.U. By clicking subscribe, I agree to receive news updates and promotional material from Mediacorp and Mediacorp’s partners.

Loading

Co-CEO Richard Teng said losses would be covered by the fund and company resources. According to US blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs, the attackers compromised Binance's "signing infrastructure", which authorises transactions, allowing them to issue instructions that emptied the affected wallets. The bulk of the heist unfolded in about 20 minutes, blockchain records show, beginning shortly after 8pm GMT (4am, Friday, Singapore time) on Thursday (Oct 29). Once the funds were moved, the attackers raced to shift them beyond the reach of Binance counterparties and stablecoin issuers, which have frozen roughly half of the stolen assets. An unusual feature of some cryptocurrencies, including major stablecoins such as Tether's USDT and Circle's USDC, is that their issuers can freeze them remotely. "In layman's terms, the attacker may not have stolen the vault key, they may have hijacked the system that tells the vault to release money," said Joshua Chu, a Hong Kong lawyer who works on crypto cases.  WHO IS BEHIND IT?  Several US blockchain analysis firms said the attack bears similarities to previous operations attributed to North Korean hackers. Teng said Binance's investigation had not yet identified the attackers, while North Korea routinely denies involvement in cyberattacks and cryptocurrency thefts. North Korea's mission in Geneva and embassy in China did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TRM said the breach shared characteristics with last year's attack on crypto exchange Bybit, which the FBI attributed to North Korean hackers. The firm said it was highly confident the same group was behind the Binance theft. Chainalysis said funds stolen in an attack last month on Bitget were being mixed with proceeds from the Binance breach.

Related:

Hackers allegedly from North Korea steal US$6.3 billion from Binance in world's biggest crypto heist

WHERE'S THE MONEY? About half the stolen assets were stablecoins that have since been frozen by issuers including Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial, the Trump family's crypto venture. That doesn't mean the coins will be returned to Binance, but it significantly limits the attackers' ability to convert them into cash. TRM said some of the funds had already been posted as collateral to borrow ether and estimated that about US$2.4 billion worth of bitcoin and ether is beyond reach. "No company issues bitcoin or ether and no company can freeze either one," said Patrick Tan, general counsel of ChainArgos, a blockchain intelligence firm in Singapore. "The bitcoin and ether can be stopped only if the attacker sends them to a crypto-asset exchange or broker that is able and willing to freeze them, or if law enforcement obtains the private keys." Market participants said the attackers would likely mix the stolen coins with other assets or use lesser known coins and exchanges to try to move the proceeds. "The more time passes, the less likely they will be able to fold those funds into other exchanges or payment providers — they essentially get blacklisted," said Bernardo Brites, CEO of Trace Finance, a stablecoin infrastructure company. "In reality a lot of the proceeds of hacks ... (can only be laundered) in the first few hours, but after that happens, you have a lot of different players who know those are marked funds ... and they usually sit there for years." WHAT NEXT? The theft is the latest in a series of major digital asset breaches. Attackers stole US$2.9 billion of cryptocurrency across nearly 150 incidents last year, according to TRM Labs. The attack has also rattled confidence in the sector. Cryptocurrencies fell on Friday and the total market value of stablecoins declined, suggesting investors were pulling money from digital assets.

Source: Reuters/rj
